steps.note: The butter is worked in a chilled case or room, about 35-40 °F, and has to feel like cold cream.

steps.name: build on frame
steps.note: Butter is plastered onto a frame of wood and wire (or steel) that holds it up.

steps.name: carve in layers
steps.note: Large amounts set the general shape, then smaller ones refine it layer by layer.

links.name: Boston Globe: how butter sculptures are made for the state fairs

sources.text: The cold work space of 35-40 °F, the butter that feels like cold cream, the wire and wood frame, and the layering from broad shape to detail, from these.
